idea: Feelings & kindness (AVA'S ROOM): Baby Ava's soft white bunny plush sits on a high wall shelf and she can't reach it ('Oh no! My bunny is up so high!'); she presses her hands together and asks 'Mommy, please! Help me, please!' (copy-me: hands together, say please); Mommy Lily gets it and Ava hugs her bunny: 'Thank you, Mommy! Thank you!'; chorus 'Please and thank you!'; Mommy offers a red apple and Ava asks the viewer 'What do we say? Hmm?' (pause) – 'Thank you!'; lesson 'Please and thank you, kind little words!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now the shelf is empty, bunny in her arm, bye-bye wave.
title: Oh No! My Bunny Is Up High! 🐰 Please and Thank You with Baby Ava | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! Baby Ava's bunny is up on a high shelf and she can't reach it! 🐰 Ava asks Mommy Lily nicely with a sweet "please" and says "thank you" – sing along and learn the kind little words with her!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Oh no! My bunny is up so high!"
🙏 Hands together, say please – do it with Ava!
💛 "Mommy, please! Help me, please!"
🐰 Bunny is back – "Thank you, Mommy!"
🍎 Mommy gives Ava an apple – what do we say?
👋 Please and thank you, kind little words! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: good manners for toddlers • say "please" when you ask • say "thank you" when you get something • English words: please, thank you, kind words

A fun sing-along cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers about saying please and thank you, with Baby Ava and Mommy Lily in Ava's cozy pink bedroom.

Kids cartoon • Please and thank you song • Good manners for kids • Kindness for toddlers • Nursery rhymes • Learn English for kids • Toddler learning
